name: Wrapped Blockle
description: wBLOCK (Wrapped Blockle) is a Solana SPL token that represents native BLOCK bridged from the Blockle layer-1 chain. Each wBLOCK is backed 1:1 by native BLOCK held in the Blockle bridge's reserve and is redeemable for native BLOCK by burning wBLOCK. IMPORTANT: wBLOCK is a CUSTODIAL, trusted-operator wrapped asset — it is NOT native BLOCK and NOT a trustless on-chain vault. Redemption depends on the bridge operator's solvency; its market price depends on pool liquidity. Verify the reserve on the Blockle explorer and read the risks at https://blockle.org/bridge before using. ABOUT BLOCK: Blockle is an independent, post-quantum layer-1 blockchain — ML-DSA-44 (FIPS-204) signatures and bech32m block1… addresses, 600-second blocks. BLOCK has Bitcoin-style fixed-supply tokenomics: a 50-BLOCK block subsidy halving every 210,000 blocks (~21,000,000 mined) plus a 210,000 genesis premine (~21,210,000 max), 1 BLOCK = 100,000,000 base units (8 decimals). BLOCK is merge-mined as a universal auxiliary chain across SHA-256d, Scrypt, X11, Equihash and more. The ecosystem includes non-custodial Qt/mobile/extension wallets, a cross-chain exchange, a native in-consensus AMM DEX, BLOCK-20 tokens + a launchpad, BLOCK-721 NFTs, an AI trading copilot, a contribution-gated social layer, and the Blockle WORLD game.
